verdict.rationale: Trigger.dev calls itself an "Open source platform" in its llms.txt, and its source is hosted in a public GitHub repository (triggerdotdev/trigger.dev). The documented self-hosting via Docker reinforces that the platform code is distributed for users to run. Missing for 10: the specific open license is never named in the evidence, and there is no independent confirmation of the license terms or of how much of the codebase they cover.
